dedupe_keys.name: tritag grand river transit corrected gtfs snapshot

description: This TriTAG repository publishes a community-corrected GTFS snapshot for Grand River Transit in Waterloo Region, Ontario. Its public tree lists agency, route, trip, stop, stop-time, shape, calendar, calendar exception and fare text files. The README says the repository mirrors regional open data so the community can track fixes, including corrections to spurious records and population of shape_dist_traveled in shapes and stop times. The accompanying Region of Waterloo Open Data Licence v1.0 permits copying, adaptation and commercial reuse under its conditions; the repository does not state an additional code licence. A modeller could use the snapshot to construct a regional scheduled transit network or compare route geometry and time consistency in a GTFS import. Its exact feed date, original package identifier, service-calendar validity and currentness against the official operator feed are not stated. The corrected fields should be treated as community changes, not independently verified operator values. The file tree and licence were inspected, but no GTFS row or operator download was fetched or validated. It supports network-flow simulation and regional service-capacity planning once its historical service period is verified.
